english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken Cantonese choice for saying that someone did something on purpose.
This is the all-purpose spoken choice for saying that someone did something deliberately.
Use this when the emphasis is that the action was deliberate or intentional, rather than merely accidental.
Use this when specifically doing something carries the additional sense of doing it deliberately or on purpose.

examples.english: I intentionally saved a ticket for you.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dak6 dang1 lau4 dai1 zoeng1 fei1 bei2 nei5
nei5 dak6 dang1 m4 fuk1 ngo5 gaa3

examples.english: I knowingly ignored the warning and took the shortcut home.
examples.traditional: 我特登唔理個警告，行捷徑返屋企。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dak6 dang1 m4 lei5 go3 ging2 gou3 haang4 zit6 ging3 faan1 uk1 kei2

examples.english: I specifically bought the cake you like most.
examples.traditional: 我特登買咗你最鍾意食嘅蛋糕。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dak6 dang1 maai5 zo2 nei5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 sik6 ge3 daan6 gou1
